title: Preflight tenant migrations and preserve attachment bytes
summary: Validate every source before any copy or deletion, preserve non-JSON bytes, and refuse destination overwrites.
reusable_steps: Validate every source before any copy or deletion, preserve non-JSON bytes, and refuse destination overwrites
expected_outcome: A tenant data migration must plan and validate all tenants before its first copy or deletion, including dry-run. Reject symlinks, nonregular entries and README directories or links rather than silently dropping them during recursive cleanup. Relink only the declared JSON/JSONL reference files; read and write all other attachments as bytes. Use exclusive destination writes and keep existing sources when a destination already exists. Exercise the actual migration under real policies in an isolated root, including invalid UTF-8 attachments, unsupported later-tenant entries, dry-run and no-overwrite cases. Copy/delete is not transactional: an I/O failure may leave a partial destination and requires manual reconciliation with source writers quiesced. Synthetic tests do not establish success on actual user data. See migration/0003-deal-home.ts and its regression suite.
